name: io.github.nirholas/robinhood-chain-mcp
title: Robinhood Chain
description: Read-only Robinhood Chain: chain state, balances, tokens, transactions, DEX pairs, scam checks.

environmentVariables.name: ROBINHOOD_MAINNET_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the public mainnet RPC endpoint (chain 4663) with your own provider URL. Leave unset to use https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com.

environmentVariables.name: ROBINHOOD_TESTNET_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the public testnet RPC endpoint (chain 46630) with your own provider URL. Leave unset to use https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com.
